spec.rationale: Reduced-knot and roughness controls improve some AUC measures but lose KS, suggesting the correction needs a different capacity constraint. Compress correlated basis directions instead of smoothing every input equally. Low-variance directions may contain important risk or thin-file information, so inspect those segments and reject if lost; PCA is not assigned semantic creditworthiness labels.
